title: Hailakandi
sub: From Assampedia, the free Assam encyclopedia
body:
Hailakandi is a town and district in the Barak Valley of southern Assam, near the Mizoram border, on the Dhaleshwari river.

History and trade

Hailakandi was historically part of the Kachari kingdom and later a tea and trade centre of the Barak Valley. Its markets serve the surrounding tea gardens and the Mizoram border trade.

Today

The district is largely agricultural, with tea, rice and bamboo, and is known for its Bengali-speaking culture and its mosques, temples and churches.
